model_annotation:
This plot illustrates the relationship between the number of completions and coverage for different model variants. The x-axis represents the number of completions (*k*), displayed on a logarithmic (base-2) scale ranging from 2⁰ (1) to 2⁸ (256), with tick labels at each power of two. The y-axis represents coverage on a linear scale, ranging from approximately 0.2 to 0.9, with tick marks at 0.4, 0.6, and 0.8.

Four lines are shown. The dark blue line with filled circle markers, labeled "Llama-3B," starts at approximately 0.43 at k = 1 and increases steadily, reaching roughly 0.90 at k = 256. The green line with filled triangle markers, labeled "Llama-3B + FT," begins at approximately 0.45 at k = 1 and rises to around 0.88 at k = 256, following a similar trajectory to the Llama-3B line but slightly below it at higher k values. The light blue line with open circle markers, labeled "Llama-1B," starts at approximately 0.28 at k = 1 and increases to roughly 0.82 at k = 256, remaining consistently below the 3B variants across the entire range. The light green line with open triangle markers, labeled "Llama-1B + FT," begins at approximately 0.30 at k = 1 and rises to around 0.80 at k = 256, tracking closely with the Llama-1B line. All four lines exhibit a monotonically increasing trend that shows a steeper rise at lower k values and a more gradual increase at higher k values.
